Complete menu map · v1.4.0 · 18 October 2026 · Zoom for detail
SIX MAIN MENUS · FOLLOW THE BRANCHES IN SHEETS 02–07
VU meter action cycles the displays; Screen Settings also controls idle displays.
Connected branches open menus. EDIT = change a value. READ = information. CONFIRM = deliberate action.
Reference: v1.4.0 firmware, 18 October 2026. Hardware-dependent rows and contextual screens are marked in the detail sheets.
